headline: Touchdown for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a short pass to X.Worthy, who caught it in the end zone for a touchdown, which is worth 6 points.
who: P.Mahomes and X.Worthy executed the play for Kansas City.
why_it_matters: This is great news for your boyfriend's team! It puts the Chiefs in the lead and increases their chance of winning by 4 percentage points.
